messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Error in Part 5 Due to 8 Specific Files
parts:
Hi Mayank,

I see a couple of things:

  • you used "minimumFileSizeMB = 0," which is not the default, the default is minimumFileSizeMB = 2 to avoid loading files that are too small for GGIR to handle. If you insist on trying to load smaller files then it is not surprising that GGIR struggles.
  • you are using "g.shell.GGIR()", please note that you can just use "GGIR()" as that is the actual function."g.shell.GGIR()" is an empty function that forwards everything it receives to "GGIR".
  • you are using GGIR version 3.1-2 which is fine, but be aware that there have been newer releases that you should consider before reporting a problem. However, in this case it would have made a difference.

Best,

Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
